messages:
olivia: Quick: need compact SDK snippets for streaming+pagination for Py/TS/Go. Aim: pattern-first + tiny adapter examples. Opening PR soon.

raj: Which patterns are must-have? resume token, partial-batch retry, and cursor TTL?

emma: Yes. Also show minimal backoff example and a note about idempotency keys. Keep each snippet under 20 lines.

docs-bot: style: no long inline prose in code blocks, prefer short comments. See docs/style.md :white_check_mark:

olivia: Python sketch: async stream, persist resume token every 5 chunks, simple retry on transient errors.

raj: TS: use for-await and demonstrate getResumeToken() between reconnects.

emma: Go: show ctx timeout + channel adapter; mention goroutine cancel.

olivia: Add migration note: older endpoint used /v1/streams -> new pattern uses resume tokens and may need client-side changes.

raj: I'll add a tiny integration test under examples/test_stream_resume.py that runs against staging key. Who will add secret?

emma: I'll request `docs_examples_key` be added to repo secrets. Also I'll draft the README steps.

olivia: Great. Please review PR quickly after I push. Target merge before docs release cut.
